name: gstin-validator
description: Validate an Indian GSTIN: checksum, state code, and regular, TDS, TCS, UIN, or NRTP/OIDAR shape. A valid checksum does not prove the GSTIN is registered. Use when a user pastes a GSTIN, checks an invoice, or builds a GST form.

name: gst-invoice
description: Build an Indian GST tax invoice, credit note, or debit note: Rule 46 fields, CGST and SGST or UTGST, IGST for inter-state, export, and SEZ supplies, LUT endorsements, and paise rounding. Use when creating an invoice, a credit note, or an export or SEZ bill. Does not file a return or call the GST portal.

name: gst-e-invoice-json
description: Build and validate GST e-invoice JSON for schema 1.1 (B2B, SEZ, export, and deemed export), including the AATO threshold and the 30-day IRP reporting check. Use when a user needs an IRN payload or a schema check. Never submits the payload to the IRP or the GST portal.

name: freelancer-export-compliance
description: Decide whether a freelancer invoice is an export of services under IGST section 2(6), and compute the financial year, LUT, Rule 96A, and FEMA realisation dates. Use when a freelancer invoices a foreign client or an SEZ, or asks about an LUT, FIRA, e-BRC, an intermediary, an own branch, or the 9-month and 15-month realisation clocks.

name: tds-freelancer-payments
description: Compute TDS on a payment to a freelancer under the Income-tax Act, 2025, section 393 (old sections 194C, 194J, and 194M), including thresholds and the no-PAN rate in section 397. Use when a payer deducts tax on professional fees, technical services, a contract payment, director remuneration, or a missing PAN.

name: razorpay-integration
description: Verify Razorpay checkout signatures (HMAC-SHA256 of order_id|payment_id), webhook signatures over the raw body, and convert amounts to currency subunits. Use when adding Razorpay checkout, a webhook, a capture decision, or an amount in paise or another subunit. Create orders, capture, and refund through the official Razorpay MCP server, not from this skill.

name: cashfree-integration
description: Verify Cashfree webhook signatures for version 2025-01-01: Base64 of HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp plus the raw body, with a replay window and millisecond-versus-seconds detection. Use when adding a Cashfree webhook, checking x-webhook-signature, or deciding whether a payment_status may fulfil. Call Payment Gateway APIs through the official Cashfree MCP server, not from this skill.

name: upi-payment-links
description: Build and parse an unsigned upi://pay link and draw a QR SVG at ECC M. Checks the payee VPA, percent-encoding, INR amount, mode, and P2P or P2M limit warnings. Use when a user wants a UPI payment link, a UPI QR, or a check of pa, pn, am, tr, tn, mc, or mode. A link is not proof of payment.

name: inr-formatting
description: Format rupees with Indian lakh and crore grouping, in words, and in short form (1.2 L, 1.2 Cr), using integer paise. Use when showing an amount, an amount-in-words line, or converting rupees and paise. Does not use Node Intl.

name: indian-id-validators
description: Format-check an Indian PAN (4th-character holder type), TAN, IFSC, PIN code, or mobile number. Use when a user pastes a PAN, TAN, IFSC, PIN, or +91 mobile, or asks whether an IFSC matches the RBI pattern. An IFSC directory lookup is opt-in and is not proof that a branch is live.

name: aadhaar-safe-handling
description: Check, mask, and scan for Aadhaar numbers with the Verhoeff checksum, and state the storage limits in the Aadhaar Act and the UIDAI data-vault circular. Use when text, logs, or a repository may contain an Aadhaar or Virtual ID. Never log a full number.

name: dpdp-compliance-check
description: Build a DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 readiness checklist: consent notice, purpose limitation, children's data and verifiable parental consent, breach timelines, retention and erasure, grievance contact, significant data fiduciary duties, cross-border transfer, and Consent Managers, with the 13 November 2025 phases and Schedule penalties. Scan Prisma, SQL, and TypeScript for personal-data fields. Use when a schema or a privacy review needs the phased dates or a field-to-checklist map.

name: sms-otp-dlt
description: Lint a TRAI DLT SMS template for {#var#} variables, the 11-character header and -P/-S/-T/-G suffix, category (transactional, service-implicit, service-explicit, promotional), URL whitelisting from 1 October 2024, and PE-TM chain rejection from 11 December 2024. Shape an MSG91 SendOTP request without calling the network. Use when writing an OTP SMS, a DLT template, or an MSG91 OTP call.
